value.checksumCommand: Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath '<ROOT>\runtimes\wsl\ubuntu-rootfs.tar' | ForEach-Object { "$($_.Hash.ToLowerInvariant())  ubuntu-rootfs.tar" } | Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 -LiteralPath '<ROOT>\runtimes\wsl\ubuntu-rootfs.tar.sha256'
messages: ClawHermes-USB does not download, build, or vendor WSL rootfs archives.
Export a user-managed, initialized Ubuntu distribution to <ROOT>\runtimes\wsl\ubuntu-rootfs.tar.
Create a SHA256 sidecar at <ROOT>\runtimes\wsl\ubuntu-rootfs.tar.sha256 before importing when possible.
Keep the archive under runtimes/wsl/ and outside system temp folders.
